records.surface: External source interfaces and API ingress
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: The active row 5.1 source files do not import concrete live-client libraries, decision-owner/persistence-owner modules, or define donor allocation/order authority classes. External source/API ingress remains an outer-boundary typed-carrier and adapter surface rather than a place where allocation, order placement, runtime, persistence, or risk authority is imported.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: A new Tier A transform-boundary family was written before source work. The family passed without source repair, proving transform-required donor allocation/config/overnight/API ideas are not silently admitted as native row 5.1 authority.
adjudication_notes: ACABC-0001 is transform-required. Donor allocation, overnight, config, and client-like ideas remain evidence for later target-shape work, not authority to place allocation/order/client behaviour inside external source/API ingress.
The generated all-surface active-code Atlas was used only as navigation and not as semantic proof.
limitations: This pass does not implement external API clients, allocation engines, order gateways, broker clients, overnight risk allocation, persistence writes, dependency additions, or live network IO.
This pass does not mutate source code, runtime trading behaviour, financial/risk policy, original Atlas/Bridge JSON, generated slices, or vocabulary data.
